description: This Java class defines a custom ViewHolder for displaying notes with an excerpt in an Android application. It manages UI elements such as swipe actions, category, status, favorite indicator, and searchable content within a note list item.

classes.name: NoteViewHolderWithExcerpt
classes.description: A ViewHolder class for displaying a note with an excerpt, supporting swipe actions and search highlighting.

methods.name: NoteViewHolderWithExcerpt
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ViewHolder with binding and click listener.

methods.name: showSwipe
methods.description: Displays swipe options on the note item, toggling visibility and background based on swipe direction.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds note data to the view, including category, status, favorite, and searchable content, and adjusts transparency if the note is marked as deleted.

methods.name: getNoteSwipeable
methods.description: Returns the view that is swipeable for gesture handling.
